items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal of hunting licence
items.quote: Binnen eines Monats ab der Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids ist der Widerspruch zulässig; er wird schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei folgender Stelle erhoben: Kreis Musterdithmarschen, Stiftstraße 8, 25746 Musterheide in Holstein.
items.computation: Bescheiddatum (document date) is 19.11.2026 (Thursday), sent by ordinary post. Under § 110 Abs. 2 LVwG (as stated in the letter) a letter sent by simple post counts as notified (bekannt gegeben) on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Monday 23.11.2026 (no weekend shift applies to this delivery fiction). The one-month Widerspruch period under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB starts the next day (24.11.2026, which happens to be today) and ends under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB one month later on the day with the same number, 23.12.2026 (Wednesday). 23.12.2026 is a normal working day in Schleswig-Holstein (not a Sunday/holiday), so no further shift is needed. Final deadline: 23.12.2026.

items.title: Submit valid proof of Jagdhaftpflichtversicherung to have licence issued
items.quote: Sobald Sie eine gültige Versicherungsbestätigung nachreichen, stelle ich den Jagdschein ohne neuen Antrag aus.
items.computation: The letter sets no calendar date or period for submitting the new insurance confirmation; it only says the licence will be issued once a valid proof is provided. No deadline can therefore be computed from the text.

warnings: The letter states the delivery-fiction rule as '§ 110 Abs. 2 LVwG' (Schleswig-Holstein's own administrative law); the deadline above assumes this provision matches the general 4-day rule used in the computation — worth double-checking the exact wording of § 110 Abs. 2 LVwG SH if precision matters.

There is no explicit deadline in the letter for submitting the renewed insurance confirmation; delaying it indefinitely means the hunting licence simply will not be issued, but no formal time limit is stated.
